tour_type.morning: 🏰 Schönbrunn Palace: Begin your day at Vienna’s most iconic imperial residence — enormous halls, golden details and royal history everywhere. → | 🌳 Gardens & Gloriette Viewpoint: Walk through perfectly trimmed gardens and climb up to the Gloriette terrace for a spectacular panoramic view of Vienna. → | ☕ Coffee & Apple Strudel at the Schönbrunn Café: A classic Viennese treat with flaky pastry, cinnamon aroma and a cozy café atmosphere.
tour_type.afternoon: 🕍 Stephansplatz: The lively heart of Vienna buzzing with street performers, shops and history. → | ⛪ St. Stephen’s Cathedral: A masterpiece of Gothic architecture with colorful roof tiles and a breathtaking interior. → | 🛍️ Graben & Kohlmarkt Walk: Elegant pedestrian streets full of historic façades, boutique shops and café terraces. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Viennese Specialties: Enjoy dishes like schnitzel, soups, dumplings or pastries in a classic Austrian setting.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Belvedere Palace Gardens (Upper Terrace): One of the best sunset spots in Vienna — golden light over baroque fountains, sculptures and palace reflections.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Museum Quarter Cafés or Youth-Friendly Classical Music Visits: MQ’s relaxed cafés are perfect for an evening hangout, and some classical venues offer youth-friendly performances with no age-restricted elements.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Schönbrunn Palace: Vienna’s most iconic imperial residence with grand halls and golden details. → | 🌳 Gardens & Gloriette Viewpoint: Perfectly landscaped paths and a panoramic terrace overlooking the city. → | ☕ Schönbrunn Café: Classic Viennese coffee and apple strudel.; Afternoon: 🕍 Stephansplatz: Lively central square with street performers and shops. → | ⛪ St. Stephen’s Cathedral: Gothic icon with stunning roof tiles and soaring interior. → | 🛍️ Graben & Kohlmarkt: Elegant pedestrian boulevards lined with boutiques and historic façades. → | 🍽️ Lunch: Viennese specialties including schnitzel, soups, dumplings and pastries.; Sunset: 🌅 Belvedere Gardens: Golden-hour views over fountains, sculptures and the baroque palace. ; Night: 🌃 Museum Quarter: Relaxed cafés, art courtyards and optional youth-friendly classical music venues.

tour_type.morning: 🌊 Hallstatt Lake Promenade: Start the day with calm water views, mountain reflections and swans drifting by — the pure Hallstatt mood. → | 🏘️ Marktplatz: The cute central square with traditional wooden houses and cozy alpine charm. → | 🏠 Traditional Houses Walk: Wander narrow village lanes lined with balconies full of flowers and old timber façades. → | ☕ Coffee by the Lakeside: A warm drink with a postcard-perfect panorama right in front of you.
tour_type.afternoon: 🗻 Hallstatt Skywalk: Step onto the panoramic deck high above the lake — iconic views you’ve seen in every photo. → | ⛏️ Salt Mine Tour (Salzwelten): One of the oldest salt mines in the world with underground slides, mining tunnels and great viewpoints. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Alpine/Austrian Dishes: Mountain-style classics including soups, dumplings, lake fish, cheese plates and warm pastries.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Lakeside Bench or Boat Ride: Golden reflections on the water with mountains silhouetted behind — Hallstatt at its most magical.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Quiet Village Cafés or Relaxed Walk by the Water: Calm paths, lantern-lit views and a peaceful late-evening atmosphere.

tour_type.morning: ⛰️ Schlossberg Hill: Start your day climbing (or taking the lift!) to Graz’s famous hilltop — full of greenery, winding paths and impressive views. → | 🕰️ Clock Tower Viewpoint: The city’s symbol — a wooden medieval tower overlooking the entire old town, perfect for photos. → | 🌲 Forest Path Walk: Peaceful trails around Schlossberg ideal for fresh morning air. → | ☕ Coffee in Hauptplatz: Enjoy a relaxed drink in the main square surrounded by colorful Renaissance buildings.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏛️ Graz Old Town (UNESCO): Wander charming alleys filled with red roofs, arcades and centuries-old façades. → | 🤍 Landhaus Courtyard: One of the most beautiful Renaissance courtyards in Austria with elegant arches and calm atmosphere. → | 🗡️ Styrian Armoury: The largest historical armoury in the world, filled with medieval weapons and armor. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Styrian Specialties: Pumpkin soup, schnitzel, Käferbohnen salad, pastries and other local favorites.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Murinsel Walk or Schlossberg Terrace: Choose between the futuristic floating island on the river or the scenic terrace high above the city for golden-hour views.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Kunsthaus Graz Cafés or Riverside Chill Spots: The famous ‘friendly alien’ museum glows blue at night, while riverside paths offer a peaceful place to unwind.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: ⛰️ Schlossberg Hill: Start your day on Graz’s iconic green hill with forest paths, viewpoints and fresh morning air. → | 🕰️ Clock Tower Viewpoint: Medieval wooden tower offering sweeping panoramas over rooftops and the old town. → | 🌲 Forest Path Walk: Shaded nature trails along the hilltop. → | ☕ Hauptplatz Café: Relaxing break surrounded by colorful Renaissance façades.; Afternoon: 🏛️ Graz Old Town (UNESCO): Winding alleys, historic courtyards and beautifully preserved façades. → | 🤍 Landhaus Courtyard: Renaissance arcades and elegant stone columns. → | 🗡️ Styrian Armoury: World’s largest historical armoury with swords, armor and medieval collections. → | 🍽️ Styrian Lunch: Regional dishes like pumpkin soup, schnitzel, Käferbohnen salad or pastries.; Sunset: 🌅 Murinsel or Schlossberg Terrace: Golden-hour light over the city and river. ; Night: 🌃 Kunsthaus Graz Area: Glowing museum exterior, calm riverside paths and relaxed evening spots.

tour_type.morning: 🏙️ Hauptplatz: Begin your day at one of Austria’s largest and prettiest main squares — full of pastel buildings, historical corners and tram lines passing through. → | 🏰 Old Town: Walk narrow streets with medieval façades, charming courtyards and plenty of local character. → | 👾 Ars Electronica Center: A futuristic museum focused on technology, creativity and interactive digital art — fun and inspiring. → | ☕ Coffee by the Danube: Relax at a riverside café with calm views and a peaceful morning atmosphere.
tour_type.afternoon: 🖼️ Lentos Art Museum: A sleek, modern glass building holding contemporary European art — colorful and inspiring. → | 🌉 Nibelungen Bridge Walk: Cross the Danube with views of both old and new Linz and enjoy the unique mix of architectural styles. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Austrian Dishes: Try local classics like Knödel, soups, pastries or light Austrian meals — great for a midday break.

tour_type.night: 🌃 Modern Cafés Near the River or Art District: Chill evening spots with a creative vibe — perfect for dessert, warm drinks or relaxing after a full day.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏙️ Hauptplatz: Start at one of Austria’s largest and most picturesque main squares with pastel façades, historic corners and lively tram lines. → | 🏰 Old Town Walk: Wander medieval alleyways, charming courtyards and old façades showing Linz’s blend of history and modern culture. → | 👾 Ars Electronica Center: Explore futuristic tech, AI, interactive art and creative digital installations in one of Europe’s coolest modern museums. → | ☕ Coffee by the Danube: Relax at a riverside café with calm water views and laid-back morning energy.; Afternoon: 🖼️ Lentos Art Museum: Discover a striking glass building filled with contemporary European art, bold colors and experimental exhibitions. → | 🌉 Nibelungen Bridge Walk: Enjoy sweeping Danube views of both the old town and Linz’s modern riverside architecture. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Austrian Classics: Taste Knödel, soups, schnitzel variations, pastries or light regional meals.; Sunset: 🌅 Danube Riverside or Schlossberg Viewpoint: Choose a golden-hour walk by the water or a panoramic viewpoint over the sunset skyline.; Night: 🌃 Modern Cafés Near the River or Art District: Stylish cafés, dessert places and relaxed riverside corners perfect for unwinding.

tour_type.morning: 🌺 Mirabell Palace & Gardens: Start your day with elegant baroque gardens, fountains and flower designs — perfect for soft morning photos. → | 🌉 Walk Across the Makartsteg Bridge: A fun pedestrian bridge covered with colorful love locks and river views. → | 🎼 Mozart’s Residence: Explore the life of Salzburg’s most famous composer through exhibits, instruments and family details. → | ☕ Coffee in the Old Town: Relax in one of the classic cafés surrounded by narrow streets and historical façades.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏰 Hohensalzburg Fortress Tour: Ride the funicular or walk up to one of Europe’s best-preserved medieval fortresses — incredible views and fascinating history. → | ⛪ St. Peter’s Abbey: A peaceful monastery complex with courtyards, ancient tombs and beautiful architecture. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Austrian Specialties: Enjoy warm dishes like soups, dumplings or schnitzel plus the famous Mozartkugel dessert for a sweet finish.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Riverside Walk Along the Salzach or Kapuzinerberg Viewpoint: Choose between golden reflections along the river or a forested hilltop overlook with magical city views.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Classical Music Cafés, Old-Town Chill Spots, or Gentle Evening Walks Through Getreidegasse: Calm, atmospheric and full of pretty lights — ideal for a peaceful night experience.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🌺 Mirabell Palace & Gardens: Start your day among elegant baroque landscaping, playful fountains and colorful flower arrangements — a gentle and photogenic morning atmosphere. → | 🌉 Makartsteg Bridge Walk: Cross the famous pedestrian bridge decorated with hundreds of love locks while enjoying breezy views of the Salzach River and the old town. → | 🎼 Mozart’s Residence: Step into the world of Salzburg’s greatest musical icon — explore family memorabilia, instruments and stories behind the composer’s early life. → | ☕ Coffee in the Old Town: Relax in a traditional café on narrow streets lined with historic façades, charming signs and pastel buildings.; Afternoon: 🏰 Hohensalzburg Fortress: Take the funicular or hike up to one of Europe’s largest and best-preserved medieval fortresses — panoramic views, courtyards and centuries of history await. → | ⛪ St. Peter’s Abbey: Wander a peaceful monastery complex with old stone passages, quiet courtyards, ornate church interiors and one of the oldest cemeteries in Europe. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Austrian Specialties: Enjoy hearty classics like dumplings, soups, schnitzel or roasted dishes — and don’t skip the famous Mozartkugel for a sweet local touch.; Sunset: 🌅 Salzach Riverside or Kapuzinerberg Viewpoint: Choose between a calm golden-hour stroll along the river or a scenic hilltop viewpoint with magical evening light over the city’s rooftops and domes.; Night: 🌃 Classical Music Cafés, Old-Town Chill Spots or Getreidegasse Evening Walk: Finish the day exploring softly lit streets, quiet cafés or atmospheric corners of Salzburg’s most iconic lane — perfect for a slow, relaxing night.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Innsbruck Old Town: Begin your day in a pastel-colored alpine old town full of medieval buildings and mountain backdrops. → | ✨ Golden Roof (Goldenes Dachl): Innsbruck’s iconic golden-shingled balcony — perfect photo spot. → | 🗼 St. Anne’s Column: A historic monument surrounded by mountain views in every direction. → | ☕ Coffee in Maria-Theresien-Straße: A relaxed street lined with shops, cafés and postcard-like views.
tour_type.afternoon: 🚠 Nordkette Cable Car to Seegrube: Ride from the city straight up into the Alps — unbelievably scenic. → | 🥾 Alpine Walk: Gentle alpine paths with huge panoramas, crisp air and incredible landscapes. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Tyrolean Specialties: Kaspressknödel, Tiroler Gröstl, soups and warm mountain-style dishes — comforting and delicious.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Hungerburg Plateau Sunset: Golden mountain light over the valley — one of the best sunset spots in Tyrol.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old Town Cafés or Quiet Riverside Walk Along the Inn: Peaceful vibe, gentle lights, and calm streets perfect for winding down.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Innsbruck Old Town: Begin your day wandering pastel-colored medieval streets framed by dramatic alpine peaks — one of the most picturesque old towns in Austria. → | ✨ Golden Roof (Goldenes Dachl): Visit Innsbruck’s shimmering icon — a balcony covered with over 2,600 gilded shingles, perfect for photos. → | 🗼 St. Anne’s Column: A historic monument standing proudly in Maria-Theresien-Straße, surrounded by majestic mountain views in every direction. → | ☕ Coffee in Maria-Theresien-Straße: Enjoy a relaxing drink on Innsbruck’s most famous boulevard, lined with cafés, boutiques and postcard-worthy scenery.; Afternoon: 🚠 Nordkette Cable Car → Seegrube: Ride directly from the city center up into the high Alps — a breathtaking transition from urban streets to rugged mountain views in minutes. → | 🥾 Alpine Walk Around Seegrube: Stroll along gentle alpine paths with crisp air, panoramic vistas and a feeling of being on top of the world. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Tyrolean Specialties: Warm up with local comfort foods like Kaspressknödel, Tiroler Gröstl, hearty soups or other mountain-style dishes in a cozy alpine setting.; Sunset: 🌅 Hungerburg Plateau: Watch the sun dip behind the mountains while the valley glows in golden tones — one of Tyrol’s most stunning sunset viewpoints.; Night: 🌃 Old Town Cafés or Riverside Walk Along the Inn: End your day with quiet cafés, soft lights and a peaceful stroll along the river, perfect for unwinding in the alpine evening atmosphere.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Esterházy Palace Tour: Start the day in one of Austria’s most beautiful baroque palaces — elegant halls, historic rooms and rich cultural heritage. → | 🎼 Haydn Hall: A stunning concert hall known for perfect acoustics and its deep connection to Joseph Haydn. → | 🌿 Palace Gardens Stroll: Peaceful paths, ponds, statues and tree-lined avenues — ideal for morning relaxation. → | ☕ Coffee at a Local Old-Town Café: Cozy atmosphere with charming historical streets all around.
tour_type.afternoon: ⛪ Haydn Church (Bergkirche): A unique historic church with Haydn’s own memorial chapel. → | 🏠 Joseph Haydn Museum: A quiet, intimate museum located in the composer’s former home — perfect for music lovers. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Burgenland Specialties: Try regional dishes rich in pumpkin seed oil, fresh vegetables and warm homemade flavors.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Ruster Hügelland Viewpoint or Palace Garden Sunset Walk: Gentle evening light over vineyards or soft shadows in the gardens — ideal for calm sunset moments.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Calm Old-Town Cafés or Cultural Courtyard Evenings (Seasonal): Peaceful vibes, soft lighting, and occasional cultural programs depending on the season.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Esterházy Palace: Begin your day inside one of Austria’s most impressive baroque palaces — richly decorated halls, historic rooms and centuries of noble heritage. → | 🎼 Haydn Hall: Step into one of Europe’s finest classical music halls — celebrated for its perfect acoustics and deep connection to Joseph Haydn. → | 🌿 Palace Gardens Stroll: Wander calm, beautifully landscaped gardens with ponds, statues, flower terraces and tree-lined paths — the ideal way to ease into the morning. → | ☕ Old-Town Café Break: Enjoy a warm drink in a cozy local café surrounded by charming, slow-paced historical streets.; Afternoon: ⛪ Haydn Church (Bergkirche): Visit a uniquely designed church that houses Haydn’s own memorial chapel — peaceful, atmospheric and full of character. → | 🏠 Joseph Haydn Museum: Explore the composer’s former home, now an intimate museum offering insight into his personal life, work and legacy. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Burgenland Specialties: Taste regional dishes featuring pumpkin seed oil, fresh vegetables, hearty soups and warm homemade flavors typical for Burgenland.; Sunset: 🌅 Ruster Hügelland Viewpoint or Palace Garden Walk: Enjoy golden light over rolling vineyards or take a serene sunset walk through the palace gardens — both offer calm, postcard-like scenery.; Night: 🌃 Old-Town Cafés or Seasonal Cultural Courtyard Events: End your day with quiet town cafés, soft lighting and, depending on the season, charming cultural evenings held in historical courtyards.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Klagenfurt Old Town: Start with pastel streets, arcaded courtyards and cozy corners everywhere. → | 🐉 Neuer Platz (Lindwurm Fountain): The legendary dragon fountain — the city’s symbol and a super fun photo stop. → | 🏰 Landhaus Courtyard: One of Carinthia’s most impressive Renaissance buildings with calm stone arcades. → | ☕ Coffee in a Local Old-Town Café: A peaceful morning break with café aromas and historic surroundings.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌍 Minimundus Miniature World: Explore iconic world landmarks in detailed small-scale versions — creative, fun and very scenic. → | 🌳 Europapark Walk: Big green park next to the lake with flower paths, ponds and relaxing benches. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Carinthian Specialties: Try Kärntner Kasnudeln (local filled pasta), soups or sweet alpine treats.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Wörthersee Sunset Promenade or Lakeside Pier Viewpoint: Calm water, warm sky colors and mountain silhouettes — the perfect chill moment.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Lakeside Cafés, Quiet Old-Town Walk, or Chill Dessert Spots: Peaceful, safe and relaxing evening options for unwinding.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Klagenfurt Old Town: Begin your day strolling pastel-colored streets, elegant arcaded courtyards and quiet historic corners that define Carinthia’s capital. → | 🐉 Neuer Platz (Lindwurm Fountain): Visit the famous dragon statue — a fun and iconic symbol of Klagenfurt with a great backdrop for photos. → | 🏰 Landhaus Courtyard: Step into one of the region’s most impressive Renaissance buildings — stone arcades, symmetry and calm atmosphere. → | ☕ Old-Town Café Break: Enjoy a relaxing morning coffee wrapped in the charm of Klagenfurt’s historical center.; Afternoon: 🌍 Minimundus Miniature World: Explore incredibly detailed small-scale versions of world landmarks — creative, photogenic and surprisingly fun. → | 🌳 Europapark Walk: Wander through a spacious lakeside park filled with flower paths, ponds, sculptures and peaceful green corners. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Carinthian Specialties: Try local favorites like Kärntner Kasnudeln, hearty soups or sweet alpine-style pastries — comforting and authentic.; Sunset: 🌅 Wörthersee Promenade or Lakeside Pier Viewpoint: Watch the sun melt into soft colors over calm water, with distant mountains creating a perfect sunset silhouette. Ideal spot for photos and relaxation.; Night: 🌃 Lakeside Cafés, Old-Town Evening Walk or Dessert Spots: End your day with cozy lakeside cafés, peaceful old-town streets or sweet dessert places — gentle and calm evening vibes all around.
